import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', 10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out NaN values and get valid age data
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
sns.histplot(age_data, bins=20, kde=True, color='steelblue', ax=ax2, edgecolor='white')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Dog Gender Distribution by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Create a cross-tabulation of district and dog gender
gender_district = pd.crosstab(df['KreisLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
# Get the top 10 districts by total dogs
top_districts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().head(10).index
gender_district_top = gender_district.loc[top_districts]
gender_district_top.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('District')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by District', fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Gender')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Yearly Registration Trends
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
yearly_counts = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum()
ax4.plot(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#9B59B6', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2)
ax4.fill_between(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#9B59B6')
ax4.set_xlabel('Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Dog Registrations')
ax4.set_title('Dog Registration Trends Over Years', fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add data labels for yearly trend
for x, y in zip(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values):
    ax4.annotate(f'{y:,}', (x, y), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,10), 
                 ha='center', fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
